records.text: Candace Owens sent out a dead man's switch to the Tate brothers, Dave Smith, Max Blumenthal, Tucker Carlson and others
records.speaker: Alex Jones

appearances.snippet: this is a real dead man's switch. She has sent out to the Tate brothers, Dave Smith, Max Blumenthal, Tucker (Tucker Carlson), and others

verification.notes: This statement attributes a public report to Alex Jones. His October 8, 2025 broadcast transcript says Owens sent a dead man's switch to the Tate brothers, Dave Smith, Max Blumenthal, Tucker Carlson, and others. The same broadcast includes Owens's clip describing a package sent to trusted recipients and specifically naming Max Blumenthal and Andrew Tate.

sources.title: The Alex Jones Show — Full Show 10/8/25 transcript
sources.relevance: Primary-program transcript preserves Jones's list and the embedded Owens clip about distributing the package.

records.text: Joe Kent was disrespectful to Donald Trump, and Laura Loomer had warned about Kent and his wife, who worked for Trump critic Max Blumenthal.
records.speaker: Laura Loomer

appearances.snippet: Laura Loomer follows up. It's so disrespectful to President Trump (Donald Trump), but don't say I didn't warn you about Joe Kent and his wife who works for the Trump (Donald Trump) hater and radical left Jew hater Max Blumenthal. Why does the White House allow these people to have wins?

verification.notes: Contemporary coverage reproduces Loomer's post that Kent was disrespectful to Trump and that she had warned about Kent and his wife. Separate reporting confirms Kent's wife contributed an article to Max Blumenthal's Grayzone, though 'worked for' may overstate a single contribution. Verification is of the quoted-post conveyance.

I mean, people all over the place—to send a package and say, "If anything happens to me and it looks suspicious, release it all."
